results.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.provclaimno,
    b.beneficiaryid,
    b.patientfileno,
    b.firstname,
    b.middlename,
    b.lastname,
    b.fullname,
    b.dob,
    b.gender,
    b.nationality,
    b.documenttype,
    b.documentid,
    b.contactnumber,
    b.ehealthid,
    b.residencytype,
    b.maritalstatus,
    b.bloodgroup,
    b.preferredlanguage,
    b.email,
    b.addressline,
    b.addressstreetname,
    b.addresscity,
    b.addressdistrict,
    b.addressstate,
    b.addresspostalcode,
    b.addresscountry,
    b.occupation,
    b.religion,
    b.prior_patient_id,
    b.created_date,
    b.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_beneficiary b
    INNER JOIN nphies_claiminfo c ON c.beneficiaryid = b.beneficiaryid
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = c.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    b.beneficiaryid

SELECT DISTINCT
    cad.provclaimno,
    cad.accidenttype,
    cad.accidentdate,
    cad.addressstreetname,
    cad.addresscity,
    cad.addressstate,
    cad.addresscountry,
    cad.created_date,
    cad.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimaccidentdetail cad
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cad.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cad.provclaimno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cct.provclaimno,
    cct.sequenceno,
    cct.physicianid,
    cct.physicianname,
    cct.practitionerrole,
    cct.careteamrole,
    cct.careteamqualification,
    cct.created_date,
    cct.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimcareteam cct
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cct.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cct.provclaimno, cct.sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cd.provclaimno,
    cd.sequenceno,
    cd.diagnosiscode,
    cd.diagnosisdesc,
    cd.diagnosistype,
    cd.onadmission,
    cd.conditiononset,
    cd.created_date,
    cd.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimdiagnosis cd
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cd.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cd.provclaimno, cd.sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    ce.provclaimno,
    ce.encounterid,
    ce.encounterstartdate,
    ce.encounterenddate,
    ce.encounterclass,
    ce.encounterservicetype,
    ce.priority,
    ce.serviceprovider,
    ce.encounterstatus,
    ce.causeofdeath,
    ce.serviceeventtype,
    ce.room,
    ce.bed,
    ce.point_of_care,
    ce.facility_id,
    ce.created_date,
    ce.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_claimencounters ce
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = ce.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    ce.provclaimno,
    ce.encounterid

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.provclaimno,
    c.episodeid,
    c.isnewborn,
    c.isreferral,
    c.referringprovidername,
    c.claimtype,
    c.claimsubtype,
    c.providernphiesid,
    c.claimcreateddate,
    c.accountingperiod,
    c.billableperiodstart,
    c.billableperiodend,
    c.coverageid,
    c.beneficiaryid,
    c.subscriberid,
    c.total,
    c.prescription,
    c.providernphiesname,
    c.prior_visit_number,
    c.created_date,
    c.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_claiminfo c
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = c.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    c.updated_date DESC,
    c.created_date DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
    ci.provclaimno,
    ci.invoiceno,
    ci.sequenceno,
    ci.servicetype,
    ci.servicecode,
    ci.servicedesc,
    ci.ispackage,
    ci.quantity,
    ci.quantitycode,
    ci.unitprice,
    ci.discount,
    ci.factor,
    ci.patientshare,
    ci.payershare,
    ci.tax,
    ci.net,
    ci.startdate,
    ci.enddate,
    ci.created_date,
    ci.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimitem ci
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = ci.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY ci.provclaimno, ci.sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cd.provclaimno,
    cd.item_sequenceno,
    cd.form_code,
    cd.form_display_name,
    cd.duration_unit,
    cd.duration_value,
    cd.period_start,
    cd.period_end,
    cd.instruction,
    cd.route,
    cd.as_needed,
    cd.created_date,
    cd.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_claimitem_dosage cd
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = cd.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    cd.provclaimno,
    cd.item_sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cm.provclaimno,
    cm.item_sequenceno,
    cm.medicine_code,
    cm.medicine_display_name,
    cm.ingredient,
    cm.strength_value,
    cm.strength_unit,
    cm.day_supply,
    cm.refills,
    cm.receiver_healthid,
    cm.category,
    cm.reasonformedicine,
    cm.handover_date_time,
    cm.packaging_code,
    cm.packaging_display_name,
    cm.dispense_type,
    cm.created_date,
    cm.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_claimitem_medication cm
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = cm.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    cm.provclaimno,
    cm.item_sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cp.provclaimno,
    cp.item_sequenceno,
    cp.procedure_code,
    cp.procedure_description,
    cp.modality_code,
    cp.modality_description,
    cp.bodysite_code,
    cp.bodysite_description,
    cp.order_identifier,
    cp.created_date,
    cp.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_claimitem_procedure cp
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = cp.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    cp.provclaimno,
    cp.item_sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cid.itemsequenceno,
    cid.provclaimno,
    cid.sequenceno,
    cid.servicetype,
    cid.servicecode,
    cid.servicedesc,
    cid.quantity,
    cid.quantitycode,
    cid.unitprice,
    cid.tax,
    cid.net,
    cid.prescribeddrugcode,
    cid.created_date,
    cid.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimitemdetails cid
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cid.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cid.provclaimno, cid.sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cpd.provclaimno,
    cpd.preauthrefno,
    cpd.created_date,
    cpd.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimpreauthdetails cpd
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cpd.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cpd.provclaimno

SELECT DISTINCT
    csi.provclaimno,
    csi.sequenceno,
    csi.category,
    csi.reason,
    csi.supportingvalue,
    csi.attachmentfilename,
    csi.attachmenttype,
    csi.code,
    csi.unit,
    csi.timingperiodfrom,
    csi.timingperiodto,
    csi.created_date,
    csi.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimsupportinginfo csi
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = csi.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY csi.provclaimno, csi.sequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    cvp.provclaimno,
    cvp.visionprescriptionid,
    cvp.datewritten,
    cvp.careteamsequence,
    cvp.product,
    cvp.eye,
    cvp.sphere,
    cvp.cylinder,
    cvp.axis,
    cvp.prismamount,
    cvp.prismbase,
    cvp.lenspower,
    cvp.lenscolor,
    cvp.lensbrand,
    cvp.created_date,
    cvp.updated_date
FROM nphies_claimvisionprescription cvp
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = cvp.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cvp.provclaimno, cvp.visionprescriptionid

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.provclaimno,
    cov.coverageid,
    cov.memberid,
    cov.expirydate,
    cov.payernphiesid,
    cov.tpanphiesid,
    cov.relationwithsubscriber,
    cov.policyholder,
    cov.policynumber,
    cov.coveragetype,
    cov.beneficiaryid,
    cov.created_date,
    cov.updated_date
FROM nphies_coverage cov
INNER JOIN nphies_claiminfo c
    ON c.coverageid = cov.coverageid
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = c.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cov.coverageid

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.provclaimno,
    cc.coverageclassid,
    cc.type,
    cc.value,
    cc.name,
    cc.coverageid,
    cc.created_date,
    cc.updated_date
FROM nphies_coverage_class cc
INNER JOIN nphies_claiminfo c
    ON c.coverageid = cc.coverageid
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = c.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY cc.coverageid, cc.coverageclassid

SELECT DISTINCT
    ce.provclaimno,
    ee.encounteremergencyid,
    ee.emergencyarrivalcode,
    ee.emergencyservicestart,
    ee.emergencydepartmentdisposition,
    ee.triagecategory,
    ee.triagedate,
    ee.encounterid,
    ee.created_date,
    ee.updated_date
FROM nphies_encounteremergency ee
INNER JOIN nphies_claimencounters ce
    ON ce.encounterid = ee.encounterid
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = ce.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY ee.encounterid, ee.encounteremergencyid

SELECT 
    e.eventid,
    e.provclaimno,
    e.eventtype,
    e.createddate,
    e.issubmitted,
    e.created_date
FROM nphies_events e
WHERE e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY e.created_date DESC, e.eventid

SELECT DISTINCT
    ict.provclaimno,
    ict.careteamsequenceno,
    ict.itemsequenceno,
    ict.created_date,
    ict.updated_date
FROM nphies_itemcareteam ict
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = ict.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY ict.provclaimno, ict.itemsequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    id.provclaimno,
    id.diagnosissequenceno,
    id.itemsequenceno,
    id.created_date,
    id.updated_date
FROM nphies_itemdiagnosis id
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = id.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY id.provclaimno, id.itemsequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    isi.provclaimno,
    isi.supportinginfosequenceno,
    isi.itemsequenceno,
    isi.created_date,
    isi.updated_date
FROM nphies_itemsupportinginfo isi
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = isi.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY isi.provclaimno, isi.itemsequenceno

SELECT DISTINCT
    pd.provclaimno,
    pd.start_date,
    pd.created_date,
    pd.updated_date
FROM
    nphies_pregnancy_details pd
    INNER JOIN nphies_events e ON e.provclaimno = pd.provclaimno
    AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY
    pd.provclaimno

SELECT DISTINCT
    ce.provclaimno,
    eh.encounterhospitalizationid,
    eh.hospitaladmissionspeciality,
    eh.hospitaldischargespeciality,
    eh.hospitalintendedlengthofstay,
    eh.hospitalizationorigin,
    eh.hospitaladmissionsource,
    eh.hospitalreadmission,
    eh.hospitaldischargedisposition,
    eh.encounterid,
    eh.created_date,
    eh.updated_date
FROM nphiesencounterhospitalization eh
INNER JOIN nphies_claimencounters ce
    ON ce.encounterid = eh.encounterid
INNER JOIN nphies_events e
    ON e.provclaimno = ce.provclaimno
   AND e.issubmitted = 0
ORDER BY eh.encounterid, eh.encounterhospitalizationid
